messages:
alicia: Heads-up: our SAST jobs are failing with KMS decrypt 403s after the keystore RBAC change that rolled 35m ago. Anyone oncall?
marco: Confirmed in staging. Error snippet: `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes.` Looks like the scanner SA lost decrypt permission.
secbot: [alert] CI job 9123 failed: sast-scan. https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/9123 :rotating_light:
owen: Which principal does the CI run as? If it's svc-scan-runner we need to grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter temporarily.
alicia: Pipeline uses `svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The rollout bound keystore-reader to group infra-team; that doesn't include the action SA.
samira: Short-term mitigation: ephemeral grant. Long-term: RBAC rollout needs a smoke test that runs a mock decrypt as the affected SA. I'll draft the runbook addendum.
marco: Ephemeral gcloud we used before:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
owen: Applying ephemeral binding now. I'll post binding id and trigger a rerun. Will also ensure audit logs for Decrypt are pulled into Splunk.
secbot: [incident] INC-2026-0934 created by alicia  tag: sdlc-scan-kms-failure. PagerDuty notified.
alicia: Please capture KMS audit slice where protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" between 1799012300-1799012600.
marco: Got it. Triage checklist: 1) grant ephemeral decrypt, 2) rerun SAST, 3) collect KMS logs, 4) rollback RBAC rollout if still failing, 5) add preflight to rollout pipeline.
owen: Ephemeral binding applied (bind-id: bnd-2026-09-30-07). Rerun queued.
secbot: [automation] Re-run requested for CI job 9123 by owen.
alicia: Rerun is green. Owen please revoke ephemeral binding and mark the rollout paused.
owen: Revoking binding now. Command to revoke saved. Also adding a smoke-test step to the RBAC deploy job to run a single `cryptoKey.Decrypt` call as each affected SA; PR incoming.
samira: I'll update runbook section "SAST KMS decrypt failures" and add the smoke-test snippet and log collection commands.
marco: Postmortem owner? alicia?
alicia: I'll own the postmortem, samira will handle the runbook PR. Marco please draft customer comms if Dedicated customers could be impacted.
marco: On it. Closing loop: revoke done, incident updated with logs. Follow-up items assigned in INC-2026-0934. :thumbsup:
